title: Longer show with jazz combo and press coverage
summary: Investors want a longer show, a combo with Tiny Grimes joins, the name changes, and papers from the Village Voice to Christian Science Monitor cover it.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: So, now after we'd go around for the Harry Joe Brown, Junior and his partner, the real estatesman from Westchester, Hustus, they wants to add another speed to the show, you understand, and they wants to prolong it, you know. So, instead of two hours they wanted us to do two hours and a half.

So, we got to get up there and reproduce. So, that's what we did. And we happened to get these virtuso musicians, you know, like jazz -- Tiny Grimes, Professor Trevorson, you see, and Jerry Citron, and Pete Peterson, you know. And we already had about three others. Well, it was a combo, you know. And -- but we had to change the name. They changed the name of the show, right. Now all of the critics that wrote about this show, most of the news -- even the Christian Science Monitor, they wrote about it. I mean it made all the copies. And the most -- the greatest critics we have in the world I would say,

And -- but the only thing about it is by us moving, they should have publicized it or broadcast it that the show had done this and done that, and was renamed, you know. The Village Voice -- I think they was the first one that did it. See, there was a gold mine, see. And some people come all the way from Russia, you know, on account of Clive Barnes or Walter Kerr. (unintelligible). One of them, you know. And this -- he used to be a colleague of you know the one that started the cancer fund? (unintelligible) and -- yeah.

So, he said he was going to start the ball rolling, which he did. He told all the other newspapers and so forth, because he was a big-time writer. So, anyhow, the public had to reinstate themselves when they found out -- they started to coming again.
